title: How Much Night Cream to Use: A Simple Guide
ex: A pea-sized amount is enough for most faces. Here is how to adjust it for your skin type and season, and how long a jar should last.
rt: How Much Night Cream to Use? A Simple Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: How much night cream to use: a pea-sized amount for most faces, how to adjust it by skin type and season, how to test it, and how long a jar should last.
keyword: how much night cream to use
quick: For most people, a pea-sized amount covers the whole face, with about half that again for the neck. Oily skin and humid weather need less; dry skin and winter need a little more. If your face feels sticky ten minutes later, use less next time.
facts: A pea-sized amount covers most faces
Use half as much again for the neck
More cream does not mean better results
A 30 g jar lasts about 6 to 8 weeks used nightly
